ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of low-intensity dark pixels with scattered high-intensity white pixel clusters covering approximately 5-10% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity black field across both lobes; distinct white focal spots and linear streaks distributed across the interior, with high-intensity clusters concentrated at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow U-shaped depression; acute angle with high vertical depth-to-width ratio at the central convergence of lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with medium pixel-amplitude variations along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated from the gray water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve from the distal tips toward the medial notch along the trailing edge; leading edge shows a smooth convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density circular white pixel clusters (barnacle scars) localized on the extreme outer tips of both lobes and scattered smaller circular points across the central dark field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent diagonal white linear disruption on the right lobe; multiple shorter unaligned white linear scratches on the left lobe breaking the dark pigment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged erosion and small notches visible along the distal edge of both lobes, particularly on the far left and right tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Widespread white stippling/mottling effect across the entire dark ventral surface, resembling a star-field pattern.
